lines: Donon jahaan teri mohabbat mein haar ke
couplets.en: Both worlds were lost in loving you.

lines: Woh jaa raha hai koi shab-e-gham guzaar ke
couplets.en: Someone is leaving after a night of sorrow.

lines: Veeraan hai maikada, khum-o-saaghar udaas hain
couplets.en: The tavern stands empty, and the jug and cup are forlorn.

lines: Veeraan hai maikada, khum-o-saaghar udaas hain
couplets.en: The tavern stands empty, and the jug and cup are forlorn.

lines: Tum kya gaye ke rooth gaye din bahaar ke
couplets.en: When you left, even the days of spring turned away.

lines: Tum kya gaye ke rooth gaye din bahaar ke
couplets.en: When you left, even the days of spring turned away.

lines: Ik fursat-e-gunaah mili, woh bhi chaar din
couplets.en: We were given a little time to sin, just four days.

lines: Dekhe hain hum ne hausle Parvardigaar ke
couplets.en: We have seen how much the Lord dares.

lines: Dekhe hain hum ne hausle Parvardigaar ke
couplets.en: We have seen how much the Lord dares.

lines: Duniya ne teri yaad se begaana kar diya
couplets.en: The world has made even your memory feel strange to me.

lines: Duniya ne teri yaad se begaana kar diya
couplets.en: The world has made even your memory feel strange to me.

lines: Tujh se bhi dilfareb hain gham rozgaar ke
couplets.en: The sorrows of making a living beguile the heart even more than you do.
